routing.adaptive_floor_engages_across_channels: PASS -> the channel-adaptive (mean-relative) floor is ready; the per-channel hand-floor sweeps (654h/485i/485j + pending 625/445/687) retire; downstream demotion retests use the adaptive floor
routing.substrate_not_ready_requeue: a channel pool is not divergent OR demotion never fires; re-queue at a longer P0 warmup; do NOT weaken anything
routing.adaptive_floor_still_no_ops_requeue: READINESS met but the ADAPTIVE floor still admits all (excluded_count==0) on a channel -> mean-relative insufficient -> mean_factor sweep / a different adaptive mode; NOT a falsification
routing.rank_alteration_not_prefix_diagnose: the eligible set is NOT an F-rank prefix on a demotion-active tick -> implementation/design fault -> /diagnose-errors; NOT a verdict
